display.purpose: Hero and top-level page headings only.

label.purpose: Prices, tags, allergens, nav items — always mono/uppercase/tracked.

shadows.name: stamp
shadows.purpose: Default offset shadow for primary action buttons — the ink-stamped/letterpress look.

shadows.name: metallic-highlight
shadows.purpose: Inner top highlight simulating a curved metal edge on glossy gold surfaces.

shadows.name: metallic-glow
shadows.purpose: Signature exception: soft glow reserved for the auth sign-in button only.

shadows.name: pressed
shadows.purpose: Active/pressed collapse of the stamp shadow, paired with a 2px,2px translate.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover/active state changes (color, filter, box-shadow).

components.name: Primary Button (Glossy Gold)
components.description: Aspirational/primary CTA — reserved for sign-in and signature moments, not general-purpose actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #1b1c1c; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #B8860B; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #F9E392 0%, #D4AF37 50%, #996515 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.45), 2px 2px 0 #1b1c1c; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #690008; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.8); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); transform: translate(2px, 2px); }

components.name: Add To Order Button
components.description: Transactional CTA — the primary 'add to cart' action, distinct from the aspirational gold button.
components.css: .ds-btn-add { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #ffffff; background-color: #690008; border: 1px solid #4d0006; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #1b1c1c; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-add:hover { background-color: #8b1a1a; } .ds-btn-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4AF37; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-add:active { background-color: #4d0006; box-shadow: 0 0 0 #1b1c1c; transform: translate(2px, 2px); }

components.name: Secondary Button (Oxblood Outline)
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #690008; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #690008; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #690008; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #690008; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #8c716e; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #8c716e; background: #fcf9f8; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip.active { background: #690008; color: #ffffff; border-color: #690008; }

components.name: Ledger Input
components.description: Bottom-border-only text input — the ledger/account-book style.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #8c716e; padding: 4px 0 8px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #1b1c1c; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #58413f; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #690008; }

narrative.overview: A single London pizza shop's own system, not a food-delivery marketplace template. The furnace is the organizing image: oxblood red as the heat and structure, gilded gold as the glow it throws off — used deliberately, not decoratively. Depth comes from hard-edge stamped shadows and metallic gradients, never soft ambient blur, which keeps the whole system feeling ink-stamped and industrial rather than glossy-app-generic. Serif display headlines carry editorial authority; mono, uppercase, letter-spaced labels carry the ledger/ticket register for prices, tags, and admin navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Oxblood + gilded gold as the dominant, deliberate identity
Hard-edge "stamped" shadows (solid offset, no blur) instead of soft Material-style elevation
Mono uppercase, letter-spaced labels for prices, tags, allergens, and admin nav — a ledger/ticket register
Serif display type for headlines, clean grotesk for body copy
Flat, bordered surfaces rather than card-shadow stacking

rules.name: The Furnace Ratio Rule
rules.body: Oxblood carries structure (buttons, active states, brand chrome) at higher frequency than gold. Gold is the glow, not the fuel — reserve the full metallic gradient treatment for primary CTAs and one or two signature moments per screen.

rules.name: The Ledger Label Rule
rules.body: Anything that reads as metadata (price, tag, nav item, allergen marker) is JetBrains Mono, uppercase, letter-spaced. Anything that reads as content (dish name, description, heading) never is.

rules.name: The Stamped Ledger Rule
rules.body: No soft, blurred box-shadow anywhere in the system except the one named Metallic Glow exception. Depth comes from solid offset shadows, borders, and metallic gradients — never ambient blur.

dos: Do use hard-edge Stamp shadows (2px 2px 0, solid, no blur) for elevated interactive elements.
Do reserve the full glossy gold gradient for primary/aspirational CTAs and signature moments — not every button.
Do keep all metadata (prices, tags, nav labels, allergens) in mono, uppercase, letter-spaced type.
Do use the 4px double-rule divider for menu section headings.
Do keep buttons and cards sharp-cornered (2px radius).
donts: Don't use soft, blurred box-shadow anywhere except the Metallic Glow exception on the auth sign-in button.
Don't make this look like a generic food-delivery marketplace template (stock Uber-Eats-style, no distinct identity).
Don't soften card corners relative to buttons, or add card drop-shadows "for depth".
Don't mix content type (dish names, descriptions) into the mono/uppercase ledger register, or metadata into serif/sans content type.
